python_modules.note: Texture generator is dependency-free. Blender scripts execute with Blender's Python, so absence of system bpy is expected.

command_caveats: npm run check covers build, validation, pack, typecheck and tests, but not rider, LODs, static profile or render matrix.
npm run check:ci covers build, validation, typecheck, tests, rider, LODs and static profile, but does not directly include canonical runtime packing or render QA.
The actual GitHub Actions workflow separately runs canonical pack and the QA smoke matrix.
npm run build:glb first generates textures, then runs tools/build_lightcycle.py in background Blender.
Runtime packing must retain gltfpack -kn -tc. The npm/WASM gltfpack package cannot replace the native binary because it lacks BasisU support.
Build, LOD, render and rider commands mutate generated files and are not read-only checks.
